title: Fitting, quality control and pricing professional work

say: Fitting, quality control, and pricing professional work.
This is the video for module five of Advanced Tailoring and Pattern Making.

This module brings everything together at the level clients pay most for. A toile is a test garment sewn from calico of similar weight to the final fabric. The real fitting happens there, and the fixes go onto the pattern.

panel.heading: What clients pay most for
items: A calm, structured toile fitting
Fixes made on the pattern
Checks at every stage

say: Then you will build quality checks into every stage, and run client work with written orders and prices you can explain.

say: Fit from the top down, because a change at the shoulder affects everything below. Fix the biggest problem first. Drag lines are wrinkles from fabric pulling or collecting, and they point towards the problem.

panel.heading: Drag lines point to the problem
items: Fit from the top down
Bust to side seam pulls: full bust
Folds above back waist: sway back
Neck to armhole folds: sloping shoulders
Ask her to sit, reach and walk

say: Diagonal pulls from the bust towards the side seam mean not enough room over the bust.

panel.heading: Drag lines point to the problem
items: Fit from the top down

Ask her to sit, reach and walk

say: Horizontal folds just above the back waist mean the back is too long for a sway back.

say: Diagonal folds from the neck towards the armhole mean her shoulders slope more than the pattern.

say: Before you finish, ask her to sit, raise her arms, reach forward and walk. Owambe gowns must survive dancing. Fit in a private, screened corner, and ask before touching near the bust or hips.

say: For example, Grace in Calabar fits a toile for a lace sheath gown. She starts at the top. Re-pinning the shoulder 1 cm lower removes the neck-to-armhole folds. On the pattern she lowers the underarm by 1 cm too, so the armhole keeps its size.

panel.heading: Grace fits and alters a lace gown
items: Shoulder 1 cm lower; underarm 1 cm lower
Full bust: spread side panel 2 cm
Sway back: fold out a 1.5 cm wedge
Sleeve: 36 cm bicep + 3 cm ease = 39 cm
Recheck cap ease; flatten to 3 cm

say: The bust pulls remain. Unpicked at the side seam, the toile springs open about 2 cm each side. So she spreads the side front panel 2 cm at bust level and adds matching length.

panel.heading: Grace fits and alters a lace gown
items: Shoulder 1 cm lower; underarm 1 cm lower
Full bust: spread side panel 2 cm
Sway back: fold out a 1.5 cm wedge
Sleeve: 36 cm bicep + 3 cm ease = 39 cm
Recheck cap ease; flatten to 3 cm

say: At the back she pinches out about 1.5 cm at centre back waist, tapering to nothing at the side seam, and folds out that wedge on the pattern.

say: The client's bicep is 36 cm, and the sleeve is only 34. With 3 cm of ease she needs 39, so she spreads the sleeve 5 cm.

say: The new cap now has 5 cm of ease, too much, so she flattens it to 3 cm.

say: A crooked dart found early takes two minutes to fix. Found after the lining and zip, it can take an hour. So check at set points against tolerances written on a spec sheet, not against looks fine.

panel.heading: Check at every stage
items: After darts: within 0.3 cm left to right
After side seams: within 0.5 cm of spec
After zip: waist seams meet exactly
Final: length within 1 cm
First garment of a batch fully inspected
Photograph front, back and inside

say: For example, Ronke in Ibadan sewed 24 aso-ebi gowns. She fully inspected the first gown and found the waist seam missed at the zip by 0.5 cm. Fixing the method then saved fixing 24.

say: Advanced pieces vary too much for a fixed price list, so price from measured time. Nkechi timed every stage, from drafting to beading. The total was 28 hours.

card.title: Nkechi prices a corset lace gown

say: At her rate of 2,500 naira an hour, her time is worth 70,000 naira.

card.title: Nkechi prices a corset lace gown

say: Materials she supplies, like lining, boning and zip, are about 25,000. Her share of overheads, including generator fuel, is about 8,000.

card.title: Nkechi prices a corset lace gown

say: That is 103,000. She adds 20 percent profit, which gives 123,600.

card.title: Nkechi prices a corset lace gown

say: She quotes 125,000 naira, and asks for a 60 percent deposit of 75,000 before cutting. These amounts are approximate examples only.

card.title: Nkechi prices a corset lace gown

say: Write every order on one page: design, fabric, fittings, delivery date, price, deposit and your terms. Send it on WhatsApp and ask the client to reply agreed. That message is your record.

panel.heading: Orders and payments, done safely

cards.d: Design, fabric, fittings, delivery date, price, deposit, terms. Client replies 'agreed' on WhatsApp.
Check every transfer in your own bank or wallet app. Screenshots and SMS alerts can be faked.
Never share an OTP or PIN with anyone claiming to be from your bank.

say: Before releasing a garment, confirm the transfer in your own bank or wallet app. Never rely on a screenshot or an SMS alert, because both can be faked.

say: To remember. Fit from the top down, and read where drag lines point. Fix the pattern and retest. Measure against written tolerances.
Price from time, materials, overheads and profit. And confirm every payment in your own app.
